heading: Procurement of detection equipment for United States border security
lead: Of the amount authorized to be appropriated by section 301,1 $15,000,000 is available for the procurement of—

tree.text: equipment capable of detecting the movement of weapons of mass destruction and related materials into the United States;
equipment capable of interdicting the movement of weapons of mass destruction and related materials into the United States; and
materials and technologies related to use of equipment described in paragraph (1) or (2).

notes.text: References in TextSection 301, referred to in text, is section 301 of Pub. L. 104–201, div. A, title III, Sept. 23, 1996, 110 Stat. 2475, which is not classified to the Code.
